mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Defense1.detail:
Details: Due to its status as the public enemy, the Civil Resistance cannot directly report that %STATION_NAME% is about to be attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%.

Our analysts revealed this information with the help of the quasimorphs themselves. They have learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. The Hexarchy immediately declares them fakes.

If we want to improve relations with the CR, then we should help them repel the attack.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Elimination1.af: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is not at all interested in details. The colnode, who was in touch with us, nodded barely and hung up. I hope the reward that awaits us in Magnum's cargo hold was worth the effort.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Elimination1.br: The sensors are almost completely blind: we observe unimaginable leaps of quasimorphosis. We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%, it's not in the contract.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Elimination1.de:
Details: the Civil Resistance has become active around %STATION_NAME%. They want to get this place, but are not yet ready for direct actions. They can be understood: %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. They somehow learned to linger in our reality for a long time. We can test the strength of their defenses.

The rebels found out that a quasimorph of the Duke type was seen at %STATION_NAME%. If we manage to eliminate it, then the forces of this faction here will be significantly weakened.

Of course, we are not doing this to save humanity. The customer indicated that the PMC that undertakes this work will receive a good reward.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Escort1.after: As a reward for saving the key colnode, the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> sent us a valuable parcel of equipment expropriated from corporations. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Escort1.briefin: Escort the key colnode to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Escort1.details:
Details: The headquarters of the Civil Resistance key colnode is located at %STATION_NAME%. Recently, they has carried out several successful operations against quasimorphs. And now %VICTIM_NAME% is about to attack the station.

If we take on this urgent contract, we need to bring the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Escort1.objecti: Another day, another mission against the quasimorphs. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the key colnode to the safe location.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Espionage1.afte: The meeting with the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnode took place. Seeing them gives me the uncanny valley effect. It's good that they got off Magnum. We received a valuable cargo in exchange for a useless rock.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Espionage1.brie:
The signature of the igvalite has been found, its location is marked on your map. Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. The rebels are really ready to reward you well for this rock.

We will try to drop you off as close to the place as possible, but we can’t promise anything: the shuttle pilot reports strange visions.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Espionage1.deta:
Details: the Civil Resistance is conducting operations related to %STATION_NAME%. Despite the suppression of information by the Hexarchy, it is known that this place is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. The rebels discovered something interesting there.

The agents picked up the signature of an igvalite - a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It appears that the quasimorphs use this location to store energy. We have work to do.

The CR offers to infiltrate %STATION_NAME% and pick up the igvalite.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Espionage1.obje: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
A large number of colnodes are arriving at %STATION_NAME%. We got what we were due: the cargo is already on Magnum.

We don't know why exactly these quasimorphs remain in our reality. As a rule, the quasimorphosis subsides soon after the violence stops. But %VICTIM_NAME% has learned to overcome this limitation. You'll have to work manually.

After disembarking, methodically move forward through %STATION_NAME% and shoot everything that moves. Keep your eyes open and try to be prepared for any turn of events. Good luck.

Details: More and more quasimorphic events are happening throughout the Solar System. All such cases are presented by the corporation as fakes of the Civil Resistance. The rebels got in touch with us and urge us not to believe the lies of the corporations. They want to recruit us to recapture %STATION_NAME% from the quasimorphs. After our victory, they will look there for evidence of the existence of quasimorphs in order to provide them to all of humanity.

Here is what we will need to do: walk through %STATION_NAME% and kill as many quasimorphs as possible. These creatures act on behalf of %VICTIM_NAME% and it is unknown how they learned to linger in physical reality for a long time.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Robbery1.after: The quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% clearly did not expect such a raid. We managed to quickly leave %STATION_NAME% before the quasimorphosis began to affect Magnum. The colnodes took the junk that we carried out for them. In exchange, they handed over some equipment expropriated from corporations.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Robbery1.briefi: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: find and pick up valuable items on each floor of the station. Smash and destroy everything you want, but take the goods. After that, evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Robbery1.detail:
For almost a hundred years now, the Civil Resistance has been waging a desperate struggle against corporations. Humanity is enslaved. But recently, a new source of hope for the rebels has appeared in the Solar System. We are talking about %VICTIM_NAME%. %STATION_NAME% has been captured by these monsters. And this is an unexpected trump card got the CR in the fight against corporations.

If we manage to steal valuable goods from the quasimorphs, the rebels will use them against capitalists.
mission.CivilRes_Xiomara_Robbery1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.CivilRes.names: Penetration;Positiff;Rip the System;Sex on the Flag;Revolution;Wrath;Ikons;Megalomania;Stray Bullet;Attack/Reload;WWIII;Bullets & Bombs;Free Your Hate;Rebels in Kontrol;Kunst;Our Time Will Come;Disturb the Peace;Down-and-out;Krank;Amnesia
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Control1.after: %STATION_NAME% continues to generate profits for %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It is extremely grateful to us for our work. Valuable cargo has been delivered to Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Control1.briefing: The location of the communication center is marked on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them all and <color=#FFFEC1>don't let the satellite dish be destroyed</color>.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Control1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has firmly integrated %STATION_NAME% into its structure. %VICTIM_NAME% has been operating around this station for some time. Apparently it needs %STATION_NAME% to establish a base of operations here.

Public enemies are planning an attack on the communication system of %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% is ready to attack at any moment.

Our task is to protect the equipment of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Control1.objective: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the transmitter</color>. It is a satellite dish aimed into space. There is a mark on your map.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Defense1.after:
%BENEFICIARY_NAME% retained control of %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% did not have enough strength for a direct capture. This means that they will now move on to more traditional terrorist actions.

Magnum received a shipment from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% in gratitude for our work.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Defense1.briefing:
It is necessary to hold positions long enough for the attackers to understand that this time they will not succeed. All the rabble belonging to %VICTIM_NAME% are heading here.

Collateral damage should not worry us. We have one mission: that %STATION_NAME% remains the property of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% when the dust settles and the smoke clears.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Defense1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is actively increasing its influence in the Solar System. The public enemies are using the chaos of the new redistribution of property for sabotage, murder, and espionage against system corporations.

%STATION_NAME% is subject to an attempt to seize it. If %VICTIM_NAME% succeeds, the asset will be removed from the market for a long time. The current owner of the station, %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, is already sending out calls for the fight against terrorism through official channels. Through unofficial channels - contracts to ensure the safety of the station. This is where we come into the game.

Simple task: we land and eliminate all attackers until they stop trying to take the station by storm. If we keep the object, the gratitude to %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be very significant.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Elimination1.after: It was difficult for %BENEFICIARY_NAME% consultant to hide their joy. Perhaps in the future it will want to recapture %STATION_NAME% completely. Then there will be work for us again. The container with the reward is already on Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Elimination1.brief: The location of the <color=#FFFEC1>key colnode</color> is marked on your map. The shuttle pilot is doing what he can, but the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has already detected our approach and taken action. You know, <color=#FFFEC1>CR</color> always scared me. People go into battle not for profit or entertainment, but because they consider something unfair. And are they even people? The uncanny valley effect, no joke.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the key colnode of the Civil Resistance.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Elimination1.detai:
Details: %STATION_NAME% is now the base of operations for the Civil Resistance. Corporations are gritting their teeth because such a rich asset does not bring profit. However, deciding to take direct actions now means facing unimaginable losses.

It seems that one of the field commanders is here - key colnode. If we want to receive the trust of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% and a valuable reward, then we should take care of this fighter for the idea.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Elimination1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the key colnode of the Civil Resistance.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Escort1.after: As a reward for retaining a valuable employee, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% sent us a package. Let's hope the manager whose life we ​​saved today was generous enough. The cargo is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Escort1.briefing: The target signature provided to us by %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is clearly visible. The location is marked on your map. <color=#FFFEC1>Escort</color> the valuable staff to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. The attackers are <color=#FFFEC1>rabble</color> from all the outskirts of the System. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but act according to the circumstances. Good luck.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the manager of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Escort1.details:
Details: An ambitious project manager for %BENEFICIARY_NAME% works at %STATION_NAME%. They are taking effective measures against the public enemies in this part of the Solar System. Of course, this does not suit %VICTIM_NAME% at all.

The Security Service of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has received information that public enemies have ordered the murder of a promising manager. We can take the contract for their protection. Not the most rewarding job, but it's a good way to improve relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Escort1.objective0: Escort is a routine job. Your task: escort the manager to the <color=#FFFEC1>safe location</color> specified by %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Espionage1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already studying the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> we obtained. It might want to take over %STATION_NAME%. Or maybe it will sell the data to the highest bidder. We'll watch. The reward has already been delivered to Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Espionage1.briefin: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has turned %STATION_NAME% into a kind of fortress. It won't be possible to land you near the target. The espionage operation to steal the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color>, not yet begun, turned into a war. The good news: we've spotted the right device. It is marked on your map. Good luck.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Take the Civil Resistance PCPU from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Espionage1.details:
Details: %STATION_NAME% is held by the Civil Resistance. The assets of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% were attacked several times by rebel forces. Now %BENEFICIARY_NAME% wants to know about their plans.

If %STATION_NAME% serves the Civil Resistance as a base of operations, then the necessary data can definitely be found there. You will need to pick up the portable computer personal unit (the PCPU) from the colnode commander and return with it to Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Espionage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Take the Civil Resistance PCPU from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Infiltration1.afte: Representatives of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% thank us for protecting the prototype. Gratitude is more like an advertising brochure about how a new product will help all of humanity. The point, of course, is not this, but the rate of profit. Therefore, our reward should not be small.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Infiltration1.brie:
Our opponents are rabble from the outskirts of the Solar System. The HIS of %VICTIM_NAME% is hovering nearby, it is irradiating %STATION_NAME% with a geoscanner. Rough work, but it has probably detected a new signature from the experimental prototype.

We need to land on the station and eliminate all infiltration teams. Be distracted by profiting from your employers' things only if it doesn't interfere with your main job.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Infiltration1.deta:
Details: Analysts were able to calculate an interesting pattern in the information flow regarding the activities of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. Agents of %VICTIM_NAME% found out that some prototype was being developed at %STATION_NAME%. Most likely, they will try to take it over because they want to close the technological gap with the corporations.

If we want to improve the way %BENEFICIARY_NAME% treats us, we need to protect the prototype.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1.aft: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is conducting an information campaign about its success in the fight against terrorism. Of course, their competitors are noticing that %STATION_NAME% is now in the hands of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. For us, this could mean a new job. By the way, the reward is already on board Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1.bri: %STATION_NAME% is at your complete disposal. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the colnodes</color>! According to <color=#FFFEC1>NCE</color>, they are public enemies. If they suffer significant losses, they will leave this place. At least, as far as we generally understand colnodes. Keep your eyes open so you don't find yourself without the necessary supplies at a critical moment.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_RaiderCapture1.det:
Details: The time has come to shine in the propaganda of the anarcho-capitalist regime. Not directly, of course. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is actively posting messages in the SBN about the inadmissibility of the further presence of terrorists from the Civil Resistance at %STATION_NAME%. This is a signal for us and other PMCs.

Task: kill as many colnodes as possible. Sooner or later, they will retreat. Should retreat.

When the job is done, we will leave %STATION_NAME%. And let the corporations deal with the new asset.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Sabotage1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already spreading information about its unprecedented success in the fight against terrorism. %STATION_NAME% is ready to be liberated by corporations. Well, if anyone wants to do this, we're always here. The employer sent us the due cargo.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Sabotage1.briefing: The location of the <color=#FFFEC1>stolen cargo</color> has been marked on your map. You may explore %STATION_NAME% if you believe there is something of interest there, but avoid unnecessary risks. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will accept nothing less than a successful outcome of the mission.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Sabotage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the Civil Resistance supply warehouse.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Sabotage1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% has long been in the hands of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. The <color=#FFFEC1>CR</color> are public enemies and are completely excluded from market relations in the System. It has to replenish supplies in other ways. Thus, one of the assets of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% was raided. Its analysts traced the attackers to %STATION_NAME%. There is a contract for <color=#FFFEC1>destruction of the stolen supplies</color>.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Security1.after: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will have to deal with the mess that the public enemies caused at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The reward is already on Magnum.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Security1.briefing: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. The corporation %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will consider it a failure if even one such squad escapes.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Security1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>, %VICTIM_NAME% is attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is requesting assistance. If we respond, we will need to <color=#FFFEC1>provide the attackers with a decent greeting</color> until corporate reinforcements arrive.
mission.Corp_CivilRes_Security1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the colnode squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control1.after: %STATION_NAME% continues to generate profits for %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. It is extremely grateful to us for our work. The valuable cargo has already been transferred to Magnum.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control1.briefing: The location of the communication center is marked on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them, <color=#FFFEC1>don’t let them destroy the satellite dish</color>.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control1.details:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has firmly integrated %STATION_NAME% into its structure and improved its position in the planetary market. %VICTIM_NAME% is engaged in fierce bidding for this asset. Obviously, as long as %STATION_NAME% is profitable, %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will not want to get rid of it.

There is one reliable way to turn a profitable asset into a loss-making one: attack the communication system of %STATION_NAME%. If the losses are strong enough, the owner of the asset %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will think about selling.

Analysis of information from the SBN shows that %VICTIM_NAME% is looking for contractors to attack the station’s communication system. Our task is to protect the equipment of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control1.objective0: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the transmitter</color>. This is a satellite dish aimed into space. There is a mark on your map.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control2.after: Great job, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% prepared and sent valuable cargo to Magnum as a reward. It seems it handed over to us what we were protecting. And our dear colleagues were told that the cargo had been destroyed.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control2.briefing: We have marked the location of the cargo on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them all and <color=#FFFEC1>do not let the cargo be destroyed</color>.
mission.Corp_Corp_Control2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the cargo of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, prepared for shipment from %STATION_NAME%.
